title: OneNote on iPhone: Copilot chat pane with page summaries and Q&A
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, licence requirement and licence-assignment instructions match Microsoft's notice and documentation. Remove the unsupported inference about data storage, and align the action rating and notebook-sharing checklist with the editorial standard.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot processes OneNote content the user already has permission to access under existing Copilot data handling and security controls.
claims.quote: Copilot chat processes OneNote content that users already have access to in order to generate summaries and answer questions, in accordance with existing Microsoft 365 Copilot data handling, permissions, and security controls.

claims.claim: The pane introduces generative AI analysis of users' note content.
claims.quote: This update introduces Copilot chat capabilities within OneNote Mobile, allowing generative AI to analyze note content that the user has permission to access.

claims.claim: The exposure follows from existing permissions rather than from a new store of data.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote iPhone Copilot chat summaries responses storage interaction history stored. Read MC1307979 and Learn copilot/plan/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy#data-stored-about-user-interactions-with-microsoft-copilot; neither establishes the feature's no-new-store inference.
claims.fix: Remove 'rather than from a new store of data'. The notice establishes access to existing content, not this storage conclusion; Learn's privacy page says Copilot interactions in OneNote are stored.

claims.claim: The notice does not identify individual policies that cover the iPhone pane.
claims.quote: Existing Microsoft 365 Copilot controls, permissions, and policies continue to apply.

claims.claim: The supplied notice describes summaries and answers, not actions taken on a user's behalf.
claims.quote: The Copilot chat pane allows users to generate concise summaries of longer OneNote pages and ask questions about their notes

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A price specific to the iPhone summary and Q&A feature is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote iPhone Copilot summary feature price credits meter license. Opened Learn copilot/plan/copilot-overview and copilot/plan/copilot-license-options; read the notice. Found licence coverage, not a feature-specific price.

claims.claim: A meter specific to this feature is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote iPhone Copilot summary feature price credits meter license. Opened Learn microsoft-365/copilot/pay-as-you-go/meters and copilot/plan/copilot-overview. Neither identifies a meter for this OneNote feature.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing > Licenses > product > Assign licenses.
claims.quote:
In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page.
2. Select a product.
3. On the product details page, select Assign licenses.

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no page specifically documenting this iPhone summary and Q&A feature at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote iPhone Copilot summary chat pane licensing price meter disable policy; "OneNote" "iPhone" "Copilot" "Summary" "422324". Read returned Learn release-note excerpts and the Copilot overview; results cover other OneNote features, not this item.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot settings page lists no setting named for OneNote.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote iPhone Copilot disable policy turn off chat pane admin. Opened Learn copilot/implement/configure-copilot-admin-center and read its complete settings lists; none names OneNote.

claims.claim: Which existing setting can turn off this pane for a group of licensed users is not confirmed.
claims.quote: Searched: OneNote iPhone Copilot disable policy turn off chat pane admin; "OneNote" "iOS" "Copilot" "policy". Opened Learn copilot/manage/manage-copilot-chat and configure-copilot-admin-center; their blocking guidance does not establish coverage of the OneNote iPhone pane.

claims.claim: The checklist tells admins to review notebook sharing, but the controls table contains only licence assignment.
claims.quote: Review sharing on notebooks that hold sensitive content, because the notice says the pane draws on content the user can already open. / Which users hold the Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) licence the pane needs
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet 'Review sharing on notebooks that hold sensitive content, because the notice says the pane draws on content the user can already open.' It names a control with no table row; do not add an unverified row.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating conflicts with the act-now definition for an automatic, imminent medium-risk rollout requiring a decision.
claims.quote: action: "prepare" / risk: "medium" / defaultState: "on" / decide whether anyone who uses OneNote on iPhone should gain or lose it before the end of November 2026
claims.fix: Change action from 'prepare' to 'act-now': on 18 November 2026, the automatic end-of-November rollout is within 60 days, the page rates risk medium, and it calls for a pre-rollout licence decision.

claims.claim: The roadmap record supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null
